title: family_get_children
description: List the child devices in this family manager's scope with their kids rules, releases, status and today's counters. Family manager devices only (effective rule family_manager); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_children.

request_id.description: Optional id of the app, echoed in the answer.
